items.q: Thad Jones used to come down there then. Well, Thad Jones got fired from messing around--down there messing around with us. He wouldn't go to work. He came down there playing with us every night.

ctx.x: Thad Jones used to come down there then. Well, Thad Jones got fired from messing around--down there messing around with us. He wouldn't go to work. He came down there playing with us every night. And, you know, when he decided to go to work, he didn't have no job.
